children: Turkey's central bank said on Thursday it would increase funding provided through one-week repo auctions, revise banks' borrowing limits and reduce collateral haircuts in light of recent developments in financial markets.
The central bank said it would closely monitor liquidity conditions and take any additional measures if necessary.
